disposition.reason: The docket is an appeal by interested persons from a Town of Manchester permit decision, but the only decision (a sanctions-discovery order) never says what the Walker II project is. New housing is not established, so the case is excluded.

evidence.quote: A group of interested persons (the Appellant Group) appealed from a decision on a Town of Manchester permit issued to Appellee-Applicant H.B. Partners for the so-called Walker II project.
